_description: Defines which ports/services are AUTHORIZED vs ROGUE on this network.
organization: IS Lab Project — Network Security Demo

21.reason: Cleartext file transfer — credentials exposed on wire

23.reason: Cleartext remote shell — complete session hijack possible

80.reason: Unencrypted web traffic — credentials and data exposed

139.reason: Legacy SMB/NetBIOS — exposes host info and shares; vulnerable to relay attacks

445.reason: SMB file sharing exposed — highly susceptible to remote code execution (e.g. EternalBlue)

512.reason: Remote execution without encryption — legacy threat

513.reason: Remote login without encryption — legacy threat

514.reason: Remote shell without encryption — legacy threat

69.reason: Trivial FTP — no authentication, no encryption

161.reason: SNMPv1/v2 uses community strings in plaintext

5001.reason: Java Object Serialization — extremely vulnerable to Remote Code Execution (RCE) via insecure deserialization

8000.reason: Unauthenticated dev HTTP server — no encryption

8080.reason: Unencrypted HTTP (Tomcat) — credentials exposed, admin console often targeted for brute force

8081.reason: Unencrypted HTTP (Jetty) — data transmitted in plaintext

_note_unknown: Ports not in either list are flagged as UNKNOWN — warranting manual review
